poll.question: Tomorrow at first light: Dan wants to drive. Hui Ling stares at their broken solar array. Fix it, leave by noon, or scavenge the city one last time?

options.label: Repair the array
options.desc: Her hands remember how. Maybe one more day of work feels like staying, not leaving.

options.label: Leave by noon
options.desc: Dan nods toward the keys. She breathes, picks up her pack. The rooftop is done.

options.label: Scavenge one last time
options.desc: One last run into the city below. To find what they need, or to not come back.

in_play.label: Work tonight
in_play.desc: Daylight is survival currency—fix it before dark hits and the cold deepens.
